"""Discardable predecessor assay; all secrets are read from a private generated env."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

install, env_file, action, destination = map(Path, sys.argv[1:5])
action = str(action)
for key in tuple(os.environ):
    if key.startswith('GARIMPEI_') or key in {'DJANGO_SECRET_KEY','POSTGRES_PASSWORD','WAHA_API_KEY','DATABASE_URL'}:
        os.environ.pop(key)
for line in env_file.read_text().splitlines():
    key,value=line.split('=',1)
    os.environ[key]=value
sys.path[:0]=[str(install/'apps/backend/src'),str(install/'apps/backend')]
os.environ['DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE']='garimpei.config.settings'
import django
django.setup()
import garimpei
from django.core.management import call_command
from django.db import connection
from django.utils.timezone import now
from garimpei.config.env import load_config,load_operations_settings

assert Path(garimpei.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(install/'apps/backend/src')
config=load_config()
result={'import_root':str(Path(garimpei.__file__).resolve()),'environment':config.environment_id,'action':action}
source_digest=hashlib.sha256()
for source in sorted((install/'apps/backend/src').rglob('*.py')):
    source_digest.update(str(source.relative_to(install/'apps/backend/src')).encode())
    source_digest.update(source.read_bytes())
result['source_tree_sha256']=source_digest.hexdigest()

if action=='migrate':
    call_command('migrate',verbosity=0)
elif action=='seed':
    from tests.factories.alert import WahaServer,serve_waha
    from tests.factories.media import serve_media
    from tests.factories.operations_lab_seed import seed_counts,seed_backup_choice,seed_protected_photo
    from garimpei.main import build_alert_store,build_robot_repository,_enqueue
    from garimpei.domain.alert.alert import Binding,AlertPolicy
    from garimpei.domain.robot.control import RobotCommand
    from garimpei.infra.gateway.alert.waha_gateway import WahaGateway
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.alert_models import FirstAlertIdentity,AlertIntent
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.assessment_models import ConditionAssessment,AssessmentHead
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.inference_models import InferenceRequest,InferencePart,InferenceControl
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.listing_models import Listing
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.robot_models import RobotControl,RobotOperation
    channel=WahaServer(recipient='100@g.us')
    with serve_waha(channel) as endpoint,serve_media() as (origin,_):
        os.environ['GARIMPEI_MEDIA_EVAL_ORIGIN']=origin
        result['corpus']=seed_counts(endpoint)
        seed_backup_choice()
        result['protected_media']=seed_protected_photo(origin)
        row=Listing.objects.select_related('latest').get(external_id='170003')
        first=FirstAlertIdentity.objects.get(listing=row)
        assert first.intent_id
        stamp=now()
        store=build_alert_store()
        delivery=store.claim(first.intent_id,Binding('synthetic','100@g.us','200@c.us'),stamp,reconcile=False)
        assert delivery
        channel.mode='lost'
        outcome=WahaGateway(endpoint,'synthetic-key',AlertPolicy()).send(delivery)
        assert outcome.state=='uncertain',outcome
        store.finish(delivery,outcome,stamp)
        assert AlertIntent.objects.get(id=first.intent_id).state=='uncertain'
        result['channel']={'captured_messages':len(channel.messages),'posts':sum(m=='POST' for m,_ in channel.calls),'uncertain_intent_id':str(first.intent_id),'uncertain_body_sha256':hashlib.sha256(delivery.body.encode()).hexdigest()}
        (env_file.parent/'controlled-history.json').write_text(json.dumps(channel.messages))
    listing=Listing.objects.select_related('latest').get(external_id='170011')
    from garimpei.domain.inference.request import AnalysisInput
    assessment_id=uuid4()
    complete_input=AnalysisInput(listing.latest_id,listing.latest.ordinal,'Controlled predecessor text analysis',(),prompt_version='condition-evidence-v4',schema_version='condition-evidence-v4',cohort_id=assessment_id,cohort_generation=1)
    pending_input=AnalysisInput(listing.latest_id,listing.latest.ordinal,'Controlled pending analysis',())
    request=InferenceRequest.objects.create(observation=listing.latest,revision=complete_input.revision,signature=complete_input.signature('controlled-predecessor-no-model'),artifact='controlled-predecessor-no-model',prompt_version=complete_input.prompt_version,schema_version=complete_input.schema_version,cohort_id=complete_input.cohort_id,cohort_generation=complete_input.cohort_generation,state='succeeded',created_at=stamp,completed_at=stamp)
    InferencePart.objects.create(request=request,position=0,content={'text':'Controlled predecessor text analysis'},state='succeeded',attempts=1,result={'schema_version':'condition-evidence-v4','findings':[],'conflicts':[],'limitations':['Controlled archival evidence only; no real inference'],'examined_photos':[],'omitted_photos':[]},metrics={'controlled':True})
    pending=InferenceRequest.objects.create(observation=listing.latest,revision=pending_input.revision,signature=pending_input.signature('controlled-predecessor-no-model'),artifact='controlled-predecessor-no-model',prompt_version=pending_input.prompt_version,schema_version=pending_input.schema_version,state='pending',created_at=stamp,next_attempt_at=stamp+timedelta(days=1))
    InferencePart.objects.create(request=pending,position=0,content={'text':'Controlled pending analysis'},state='pending')
    assessment=ConditionAssessment.objects.create(id=assessment_id,listing=listing,observation=listing.latest,input_fingerprint='a'*64,policy_version='controlled-predecessor',prompt_version='condition-evidence-v4',schema_version='condition-evidence-v4',model_revision='controlled-no-model',input_snapshot={'controlled':True},generation=1,status='partial',condition='uncertain',reason='controlled_archival',inference_refs=[str(request.id)],result={'controlled':True,'limitation':'No real inference'},created_at=stamp,updated_at=stamp,analyzed_at=stamp)
    AssessmentHead.objects.create(listing=listing,observation=listing.latest,input_fingerprint=assessment.input_fingerprint,current=assessment,generation=1,updated_at=stamp)
    result['technical_job_id']=_enqueue('garimpei.local_analysis','inference',86400)
    assert result['technical_job_id']>0
    InferenceControl.objects.update_or_create(pk=1,defaults={'paused':True,'reason':'controlled_predecessor_pause'})
    robot=RobotControl.objects.get(pk='local')
    build_robot_repository().command(RobotCommand(uuid4(),False,robot.revision))
    robot.refresh_from_db()
    RobotOperation.objects.create(installation=robot,stage='controlled_uncertain',unit_key='predecessor-unit',input_revision='1',resource_generation=1,control_epoch=robot.epoch,state='unknown',reason='controlled_terminal_unknown',worker_reference='controlled-predecessor')
elif action=='backup':
    from garimpei.main import build_backup_repository
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.operations_models import BackupRecord
    repository=build_backup_repository()
    identity=repository.create()
    record=BackupRecord.objects.get(pk=identity)
    path=load_operations_settings().backup_dir/record.file_key
    result.update(id=str(identity),archive=str(path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),snapshot_at=record.snapshot_at.isoformat(),scope=record.scope)
elif action=='restore':
    from garimpei.main import build_backup_repository,build_recovery_guard
    source=json.loads((destination.parent/'source-backup.json').read_text())
    identity=build_backup_repository().restore(source['archive'],isolated=True)
    assert build_recovery_guard()()
    result.update(id=str(identity),recovery_blocked=True)
elif action=='barrier':
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.operations_models import RecoveryBarrier
    from garimpei.main import build_recovery_guard
    data=json.loads((destination.parent/'source-backup.json').read_text())
    stamp=now()
    RecoveryBarrier.objects.update_or_create(installation=config.environment_id,defaults={'backup_id':data['id'],'snapshot_at':stamp,'restored_at':stamp,'state':'blocked','evidence':{'controlled_predecessor_adoption':True}})
    settings=load_operations_settings()
    settings.recovery_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    settings.recovery_file.write_text(json.dumps({'backup_id':data['id'],'state':'blocked'}))
    assert build_recovery_guard()()
    result['recovery_blocked']=True
elif action=='probe':
    from tests.factories.alert import WahaServer,serve_waha
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.alert_models import AlertIntent
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.robot_models import RobotControl
    from garimpei.main import build_alert_handler,build_recovery_guard
    channel=WahaServer(recipient='100@g.us')
    original=list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    with serve_waha(channel) as endpoint:
        os.environ['GARIMPEI_ALERT_FIXTURE_URL']=endpoint
        os.environ.update(GARIMPEI_ALERTS_ENABLED='true',GARIMPEI_WAHA_SESSION='synthetic',GARIMPEI_WAHA_RECIPIENT='100@g.us',GARIMPEI_WAHA_ACCOUNT='200@c.us')
        assert not RobotControl.objects.get(pk='local').requested_enabled
        assert build_recovery_guard()()
        for stage in ('ingest','adopt','refresh','reconcile','send'):
            build_alert_handler(stage).execute()
    assert original==list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    assert not [m for m,_ in channel.calls if m=='POST']
    result.update(recovery_blocked=True,posts=0,intents_preserved=True)
elif action=='media-read':
    from django.test import Client
    from garimpei.main import build_media_store
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.media_models import MediaAsset
    from garimpei.infra.queries.media.postgres_queries import PostgresMediaQueries
    media=build_media_store();queries=PostgresMediaQueries();verified=[]
    for asset in MediaAsset.objects.filter(state='available',thumbnail_state='ready'):
        original=queries.file(asset.listing_id,asset.id,'original')
        thumbnail=queries.file(asset.listing_id,asset.id,'miniatura')
        assert original and thumbnail
        original_bytes=media.read(original);thumbnail_bytes=media.read(thumbnail)
        response=Client(HTTP_HOST='127.0.0.1').get(f'/ofertas/{asset.listing_id}/imagens/{asset.id}/original/')
        assert response.status_code==200
        assert hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest()==asset.sha256
        verified.append({'asset_id':str(asset.id),'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest(),'thumbnail_sha256':hashlib.sha256(thumbnail_bytes).hexdigest(),'http_status':response.status_code})
    assert verified
    result['verified']=verified
elif action=='new-backup':
    from garimpei.main import build_backup_repository
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.alert_models import AlertIntent
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.operations_models import BackupRecord
    before=list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    repository=build_backup_repository()
    repository._archives._prepare(0)
    identity=repository.create()
    record=BackupRecord.objects.get(pk=identity)
    assert record.state=='completed'
    path=load_operations_settings().backup_dir/record.file_key
    metadata,files=repository._archives.read(path)
    assert str(metadata['id'])==str(identity) and files
    assert before==list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    result.update(id=str(identity),completed=True,archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),owner_marker_correct=(load_operations_settings().backup_dir/'.garimpei-backup-owner').read_text()==config.environment_id,original_receipts_preserved=True)
    assert result['owner_marker_correct']
elif action=='worker':
    import time
    import psutil
    from garimpei.infra.runtime.processes import start_process,stop_process
    from garimpei.infra.worker.probe_service import begin_run,end_run
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.models import RuntimeProbe
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.alert_models import AlertIntent
    original=list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    result['runs']=[]
    for index in range(2):
        run_id=str(uuid4())
        os.environ['GARIMPEI_RUN_ID']=run_id
        os.environ['PYTHONPATH']=str(install/'apps/backend/src')+os.pathsep+str(install/'apps/backend')
        begin_run(config,run_id)
        record=start_process([sys.executable,str(install/'apps/backend/manage.py'),'runworker'],install/'apps/backend',dict(os.environ),destination.parent/f'worker-{index}.log')
        try:
            deadline=time.monotonic()+30
            while not RuntimeProbe.objects.filter(environment_id=config.environment_id,run_id=run_id,completed_at__isnull=False).exists():
                assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'worker did not consume real runtime probe'
                time.sleep(.1)
            groups=[p for p in psutil.Process(record['pid']).children(recursive=True) if '--queue-group' in p.cmdline()]
            assert len(groups)==7,len(groups)
            result['runs'].append({'runtime_probe_completed':True,'reserved_consumers':len(groups)})
        finally:
            stop_process(record,install,10)
            end_run(config)
    assert original==list(AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id').values('id','state','body','confirmed_message'))
    result['receipts_preserved']=True
elif action=='inventory':
    reference_path=destination.parent/'reference-columns.json'
    reference=json.loads(reference_path.read_text()) if reference_path.exists() else None
    tables={}
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename")
        names=[r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
        for table in names:
            cursor.execute('SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=%s AND table_name=%s ORDER BY ordinal_position',['public',table])
            columns=[r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
            selected=reference.get(table,columns) if reference else columns
            selector=','.join(connection.ops.quote_name(n) for n in selected)
            cursor.execute('SELECT '+selector+' FROM '+connection.ops.quote_name(table))
            rows=sorted([json.dumps(r,default=str,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) for r in cursor.fetchall()])
            tables[table]={'columns':selected,'count':len(rows),'sha256':hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(rows).encode()).hexdigest()}
    result['tables']=tables
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position")
        result['database_columns_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(cursor.fetchall(),default=str,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
    from garimpei.infra.gateway.operations.snapshot_gateway import schema_hash
    result['business_schema_sha256']=schema_hash()
    if not reference:
        reference_path.write_text(json.dumps({t:r['columns'] for t,r in tables.items()}))
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.alert_models import AlertIntent
    from garimpei.infra.persistence.listing_models import Listing
    result['listing_ids']=list(Listing.objects.order_by('id').values_list('id',flat=True))
    result['receipts']=[{'id':str(r.id),'state':r.state,'body_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.body.encode()).hexdigest(),'confirmed_message':r.confirmed_message} for r in AlertIntent.objects.order_by('id')]
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT to_jsonb(j) FROM procrastinate_jobs j WHERE task_name='garimpei.local_analysis' ORDER BY id")
        jobs=[json.loads(r[0]) if isinstance(r[0],str) else r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
        result['original_technical_queue']=[{'id':r['id'],'state':r['status'],'row_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()} for r in jobs]
        cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM django_migrations WHERE app='runtime' ORDER BY name")
        result['runtime_migrations']=[r[0] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
else:
    raise ValueError(action)
destination.write_text(json.dumps(result,default=str,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'action':action,'environment':config.environment_id,'result_file':str(destination)}))

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
for step in ('prepare','seed','f17','snapshot','inventory-before','adopt','restart','rollback','cleanup'):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'.runtime/predecessor-proof.py'),step],cwd=root,check=True)
